title: Checkmate? Barbers says evidence vs VP Sara hard to counter

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has been checkmated in her impeachment trial as the evidence presented against her is hard to debunk and dispute, prosecution panel spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers said on Tuesday. Barbers, in a press briefing, said it is hard to fathom how the documents and testimonies from government officials will be refuted once Duterte’s lawyers get the chance to present their own evidence and witnesses before the Senate impeachment court. “Well para sa akin, yes, checkmate. Bakit? ’Yon nga ang aking paniwala, napakahirap pasinungalingan (ng ebidensya). Kung ika-counter mo lang naman ’yong mga testigong iniharap natin, […]... Keep on reading: Checkmate?
